content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is an object storage solution designed to provide fast and scalable storage for digital products while offering seamless delivery through Cloudflare's global network. For digital creators, this means they can store their products securely and deliver them instantly without relying on traditional payment platforms that often impose high fees. Unlike Gumroad, which takes a 10% cut from sales, NOWPayments integrates directly with R2 at a mere 0.5% fee, allowing creators to retain more of their earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture involves integrating Cloudflare R2 for storage, with Cloudflare Workers handling delivery logic. When a customer makes a purchase, a payment confirmation is sent to a Cloudflare Worker, which then retrieves the digital product from R2 and delivers it to the customer. This end-to-end process is automated and efficient, meaning creators can focus on their craft rather than technical hurdles. Additionally, by utilizing NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, creators can bypass the complexities of traditional payment systems entirely.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where mainstream payment processors are unavailable or unreliable. It empowers individuals in countries such as Nigeria, Kenya, and Venezuela to establish independent online stores without the constraints of conventional platforms. By using Cloudflare R2 alongside NOWPayments, creators can operate their businesses freely, retain full ownership of their data, and maximize their profits without sacrificing their creative vision.
Retain more earnings by using NOWPayments' 0.5% fee instead of Gumroad's 10%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The system is comprised of several key components: Cloudflare R2 for storage, Cloudflare Workers for backend processing, and NOWPayments for payment processing. Each piece plays a critical role in ensuring that digital products are stored securely, delivered instantly, and sold efficiently. R2 provides a highly available and cost-effective storage solution, while Workers allow for custom logic to be applied during the transaction process. NOWPayments facilitates smooth crypto transactions, ensuring creators receive their payments quickly and without hassle.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first set up a Cloudflare account and create a new R2 bucket for storing your digital products. Next, configure Cloudflare Workers to handle payment confirmations and product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless crypto payments, ensuring you can accept a variety of cryptocurrencies. With these components in place, you can launch your digital store efficiently, providing instant access to your products without worrying about platform fees or restrictions.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe is achievable with infrastructure like Cloudflare R2 combined with NOWPayments. By using these tools, you can store your digital products securely and accept cryptocurrency payments directly, avoiding the high fees charged by conventional platforms. This allows for a more profitable business model while maintaining full control over your products.
Cloudflare R2 ensures your digital products are stored securely and delivered instantly.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell ebooks, templates, or other digital downloads without relying on payment processors like Gumroad, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides everything you need to build and deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online by using Cloudflare R2 for storage and NOWPayments for processing cryptocurrency payments. This allows you to bypass traditional platforms and retain more of your earnings.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Utilizing Cloudflare R2 along with NOWPayments allows you to sell digital downloads with minimal fees, as NOWPayments charges only 0.5% compared to the higher rates of platforms like Gumroad.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, by leveraging Cloudflare R2 for storage and integrating NOWPayments, you can sell templates and fonts directly while maintaining full control over your sales and reducing costs.
Is it possible to automate product delivery?
Absolutely. By using Cloudflare Workers, you can automate the delivery of your digital products immediately after a successful payment confirmation.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to cater to a global audience with diverse payment preferences, all while keeping transaction fees low.
